cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Stay for tea. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation without crying.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then skip the kettle. Let me practise telling you before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without apologising to you. Then I'll try telling them myself.

confusable: D74 waits for relationship repair; D98 waits for steadiness before an external next task.
comparison: A hospital announcement rehearsal differs from becoming able to make one cup alone in a new flat.
seedUse: Use D98-a tea already exhausted and taxi deadline causing a specific two-minute rehearsal; no medical advice is involved.
